Trail Technology · Unit 8: Magnetism & Wireless Technology · Module 6

Magnetism

Magnetic poles and fields, the force on a moving charge and on a current, and how motors and sensors use it.

Lesson coming

The question

How does a magnet on a spoke tell your bike computer how fast you’re going?

The physics

  • Magnetic poles and domains
  • Magnetic fields
  • Force on a moving charge
  • Force on a current-carrying wire
  • Motors
  • Hall-effect sensors

The math

  • F = qvB sin θ
  • F = BIL sin θ

Learning objectives

  • Describe magnetic poles and field lines
  • Find the force on a moving charge in a magnetic field
  • Find the force on a current-carrying wire
  • Explain how an electric motor turns current into rotation
  • Explain how a magnet and sensor measure wheel speed

Helps to know first: Current, Resistance and Ohm’s Law.

The mountain biking connection

E-bike motors turn magnetic forces into torque. Wheel and speed sensors detect a passing magnet, some with Hall-effect chips.
